transcript.speaker: Heard
transcript.text: Hi, I’m Gogo. I’m building RoomPilot today: it helps me turn live conversations into the next useful move.

transcript.speaker: Heard
transcript.text: I’m Camille. Nice to meet you. I work with founder programs around events, so I’ve seen this kind of problem a lot.

transcript.speaker: Gogo
transcript.text: Nice. How has the hackathon been for you so far? It’s a pretty intense room.

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: Yeah, intense but good. I’ve had too much coffee already, but the projects are strong.

transcript.speaker: Gogo
transcript.text: I built this RoomPilot demo today, but I’m honestly not sure what the next step is after the hackathon. I don’t want it to just become another weekend project.

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: Yeah, that happens a lot. You get a demo working, everyone says it’s cool, and then Monday comes and nobody knows who to talk to.

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: The real risk is that the demo dies after the weekend.

transcript.speaker: Gogo
transcript.text: That is exactly what I’m worried about. Who do you think would actually care enough to try something like this next week?

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: I’d talk to someone at Hexa. They see a lot of founder meetings and event follow-up problems. There’s probably a team or partner there who would understand this immediately.

transcript.speaker: Gogo
transcript.text: Okay, that helps. Who at Hexa would be the right first person to talk to?

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: Maybe Nick. I don’t know if he owns this exactly, but he’d know who does. I can send you his email, or you can probably find him on LinkedIn.

transcript.speaker: Gogo
transcript.text: Amazing. I’ll keep it light. What should I ask him without sounding like I’m pitching too hard?

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: Just say you tested it live at Tech Europe and want to know whether this helps founders avoid losing useful conversations after events.

transcript.speaker: Gogo
transcript.text: That’s perfect. Thanks, Camille. Good luck with the rest of the demos.

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: You too. I’ll send Nick’s contact later if I find the right one.
